text.en:
The Committee
on Infrastructure
(INFRACOM) of the NEDA
Board shall, subject to approval of the President, formulate
and promulgate
the rules and regulations
to implement
the amendment
to Executive
No. 302, series of 1996, embodied in Section 1 of this Executive Order.
The Secretary
of National
Defense shall issue rules
regulations
to implement
Section 2 of this Executive Order.
5.
implementing
rules and regulations
is held invalid, the other provisions
affected thereby shall remain valid and continue
in operation.
All other orders,
memorandum
regulations, and other issuances inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
